purpose: Controlled start/end date range picker with preset shortcuts and validation feedback for time-window filtering.
useWhen: Filtering a list or dashboard by a start and end date (e.g. created between, updated between).
Offering common presets (last 7 days, last 24 hours) alongside a manual date range.

avoidWhen.reason: A single date is sufficient — use a plain date input instead.
Timezone conversion or a standalone time-of-day value is required — use time-field for the latter.
